owasp_api_cross_reference: API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration / injection class — SQL injection in product search and XSS via unsanitized order notes
summary: Product search concatenates the q parameter into raw SQL (LIKE '%{q}%'), and order notes are rendered with Jinja2 |safe, enabling SQL injection and stored XSS.

evidence.description: Detection suite asserting parameterized product search and HTML-escaped order notes; fails on vulnerable red-phase search and |safe rendering.
